Name: Ahinoam, Daughter of Ahimaaz
Summary: Ahinoam, daughter of Ahimaaz, was the wife of Saul and the mother of his sons and daughters.
KeyStory: Ahinoam was queen beside Israel's first king through his whole troubled reign.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Ahimaaz, Father of Ahinoam
LifeLesson: Queenship beside a declining king is its own quiet endurance.
